parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Result Parameter to represent whether the NS Lookup was successful or not.

parameters.name: AnswerType
parameters.description: Result parameter to represent whether the answer is Authoritative or not.

parameters.name: HostNameReturned
parameters.description: Result parameter to represent the fully qualified name for the Host Name in the calling parameter (e.g. HostName.DomainName); if no response was provided, then this parameter is {{empty}}.

parameters.name: IPAddresses
parameters.description: {{list}} Indicates the IP Address results returned by the NS Lookup; if no response was provided, then this parameter is {{empty}}.

parameters.name: DNSServerIP
parameters.description: Result parameter to represent the actual DNS Server IP address that the NS Lookup used.

parameters.name: ResponseTime
parameters.description: Response time (for the first response packet) in {{units}}, or 0 if no response was received.

object.description: Results from the most recent invocation of the test, one instance per repetition.
